    forced_words = case["forced_words"]
    token_budget = case["token_budget"]

        v = word_scores[idx]

            dp[i][c] = best

    c = remaining_budget
    for i in range(m, 0, -1):
        idx = other_indices[i - 1]
        w = weights[idx]
        v = word_scores[idx]
        if c >= w and dp[i][c] == dp[i - 1][c - w] + v:
            selected_others.append(idx)
            c -= w
    selected_words = sorted(list(forced_set) + selected_others)
    retained = []
    for idx in selected_words:
        retained.extend(word_token_indices[idx])
    tokens_used = sum(weights[idx] for idx in selected_words)
    return {
        "retained_token_indices": retained,
        "selected_words": selected_words,
        "tokens_used": tokens_used
    }"
}
